items.label: Iran conflict -- continued escalation, no de-escalation; Iran to declare new restricted zone near Strait of Hormuz
items.detail: New developments since the 2026-09-06 report (live web search, Sept 6 sources): Iran/IRGC claimed on Sept 6 it attacked a US naval drone (unmanned surface vessel) attempting to enter the Strait of Hormuz, and separately struck 3 more oil tankers on an 'unauthorised route' plus 3 more vessels it called 'America-affiliated' (Malay Mail, SCMP, Euronews, ABC News, all Sept 6). Iran's top security official Mohsen Rezaei announced Iran will declare a new 'prohibited/restricted zone' outside the Strait of Hormuz in the coming days, with any vessel entering without Iranian coordination facing sanctions -- markets read this as reducing the odds of restored normal Hormuz traffic (Arab News, Al Jazeera, SBS, Sept 6). CENTCOM confirmed it has redirected 92 commercial vessels, disabled 3, and boarded 2 more to enforce its naval blockade -- a materially larger shipping-disruption figure than the 2026-09-06 report cited (Al Jazeera live updates, Sept 6). No ceasefire is in effect. Brent crude closed $96.82/bbl on Sept 6 (+0.56% d/d, +9% on the week, TradingEconomics). The account holds no direct oil & gas exposure (CCJ is a uranium miner, not oil & gas) but remains 69.54% concentrated in SPY5+SPYL, which would be hit hard by any broad equity selloff or oil-driven inflation surprise.
items.recommendation: Do not add to SPY5/SPYL or initiate new discretionary equity purchases while the Strait of Hormuz restricted-zone declaration and shipping disruption remain unresolved. Accelerate the DBC and TLT diversification actions in this report -- both would partially cushion an oil/inflation-driven equity shock -- rather than waiting for the next scheduled review.

items.label: Process note -- hedge/cluster correlations were briefly carried forward from 2026-09-06, then corrected in-place with fresh, individually-verified numbers once the background recompute finished
items.detail: The background subagent tasked with recomputing the 7-hedge-candidate x 3-cluster correlation matrix ran far slower than usual this run (~16 minutes, 55 tool calls); rather than risk hand-parsing 19 large unlabeled price-history payloads on the main thread and mis-attributing one to the wrong ticker, this report was initially filed with the 2026-09-06 correlation figures carried forward and explicitly labeled stale. The subagent has since completed -- it caught and self-corrected an internal ticker-mislabeling issue during its own work (verified against the known AI/tech-cluster baseline of ~+0.26 before finalizing), then re-verified every ticker individually. All correlation figures in this report (items above, hedge_analysis, and diversification_actions below) have been updated in-place with these fresh, individually-verified 1-year daily-return correlations -- none of the figures moved by a meaningful amount versus the carried-forward 2026-09-06 values, consistent with unchanged holdings.
items.recommendation: None needed this run -- the correction is already applied below. If a future run's correlation recompute stalls again, keep using the carry-forward-with-disclosure fallback rather than hand-parsing price histories, and correct in-place once the recompute finishes, as done here. Separately, note that today (2026-09-07) is US Labor Day -- US markets are closed, so the daily_pnl figures below for US-listed names (CRWV, TTWO, FCX, CCJ, GEV, GOOG, LLY, NEM, KGC) are IBKR's carried-forward Friday 2026-09-04 session P&L, not a new trading session; only the LSE-listed legs (SPY5, SPYL, IGLN, REMX, SSLV) reflect an actual live Monday session, which was near-flat.
